standard.summary: 每张图可以有多种 caption 变体（不同 .txt 后缀或 JSON 字段），训练时按调度策略在变体之间切换。增强模型对不同标注风格的鲁棒性。
standard.effect: 例如一张图同时有 .txt（标准 tag）、.tag（精简 tag）、.desc（自然语言描述）三种变体。训练时交替使用，模型学会适应不同 prompt 风格。
standard.whenToUse: 数据集有多种标注来源或想增强 prompt 泛化时。
standard.avoidWhen: 只有一种 caption 格式时不需要。

standard_en.summary: Each image may carry several caption variants (different .txt suffixes or JSON fields), and training switches between them on a schedule. It makes the model robust to different captioning styles.
standard_en.effect: One image might have .txt (standard tags), .tag (condensed tags) and .desc (a natural-language description). Training alternates between them, so the model learns to handle different prompt styles.
standard_en.whenToUse: When the dataset has several captioning sources, or when you want broader prompt generalisation.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Not needed when there is only one caption format.

advanced.principle: caption_variants 是 JSON 数组：每个变体指定 suffix（文件后缀）、shuffle（是否打乱）、dropout（丢弃率）。caption_variant_schedule 控制切换策略：alternate 交替、ratio 按比例、curriculum 先易后难、custom 自定义序列。caption_variant_loss_adaptive 根据每个变体的 loss 动态调整比例。
advanced.intervention: DataLoader 每步按 schedule 选择变体 → 读取对应文件 → 应用该变体的 shuffle/dropout 设置。
advanced.expectedImpact: 增强 prompt 灵活性。在同时使用 danbooru tag 和自然语言推理的场景下效果显著。
advanced.tradeoffs: 与 cache_text_encoder_outputs 配合时，每种变体需要单独缓存。

advanced_en.principle: caption_variants is a JSON array: each variant specifies suffix (file suffix), shuffle (whether to shuffle), dropout (drop rate). caption_variant_schedule controls switching: alternate rotation, ratio by proportion, curriculum easy-to-hard, custom sequence. caption_variant_loss_adaptive dynamically adjusts ratios from each variant's loss.
advanced_en.intervention: Each step the DataLoader selects a variant by schedule → reads the corresponding file → applies that variant's shuffle/dropout settings.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Enhances prompt flexibility. Especially effective when mixing danbooru tags with natural-language inference.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Combined with cache_text_encoder_outputs, each variant needs its own cache.
